Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

Dim gns_SIHi As NotesSession Dim gnuiws_SIHi As NotesUIWorkspace
' Nom des variables ' -------------------------- Const gc_NomItemDate_SIHi = "SIHi_Date" Const gc_NomItemUser_SIHi = "SIHi_User" Const gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi = "SIHi_Statut" Const gc_NomItemComm_SIHi = "SIHi_Commentaire" Const gc_NomItemRT_SIHi = "SIHi_Historique"
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIHi = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIHi = "SI_Historique"
Sub SIHi_Initialisations If gns_SIHi Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIHi = New NotesSession End If End Sub

Function SIHi_DemanderCommentaire(p_Commentaire As String, Byval p_Titre As String, Byval p_Message As String, _ Byval p_NoCancel As Boolean, Byval p_Obligatoire As Boolean) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Demander le commentaire à créer/modifier ' Paramètres: p_Commentaire String. Le commentaire à modifier. Pour un ' nouveau commentaire passer à nul. (E/S) ' p_Titre String. Le titre de la fenêtre du commentaire. ' p_Message String. Le message à afficher dans la fenêtre du ' commentaire. ' p_NoCancel Boolean. Indique si l'utilisateur peut annuler la ' saisie du commentaire. ' p_Obligatoire Boolean. Indique si le commentaire est obligatoire '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim s As String Dim v_Commentaire As String
SIHi_DemanderCommentaire = False
' Initialisations ' ------------------ Call SIHi_Initialisations Call SIHi_InitialisationsUI
' Demander le commentaire ' ------------------------------------- Set nd = New NotesDocument(gns_SIHi.CurrentDatabase) nd.Form = "DB_SIHi" nd.SIHi_Commentaire = p_Commentaire nd.SIHi_Obligatoire = Cint(p_Obligatoire) nd.SIHi_Message = p_Message If gnuiws_SIHi.Dialogbox("DB_SIHi", True, True, p_NoCancel, False, False, False, p_Titre, nd, True, False, False) Then v_Commentaire = xVar(nd, "SIHi_Commentaire", "")
' Supprimer les lignes blanches ' ------------------------------------------ Do While v_Commentaire <> "" And (Left(v_Commentaire, 1) = " " Or _ Left(v_Commentaire, 1) = Chr$(10) Or Left(v_Commentaire, 1) = Chr$(13)) v_Commentaire = Right(v_Commentaire, Len(v_Commentaire) - 1) Loop Do While v_Commentaire <> "" And (Right(v_Commentaire, 1) = " " Or _ Right(v_Commentaire, 1) = Chr$(10) Or Right(v_Commentaire, 1) = Chr$(13) _ Or Right(v_Commentaire, 1) = Chr$(9)) v_Commentaire = Left(v_Commentaire, Len(v_Commentaire) - 1) Loop
p_Commentaire = v_Commentaire SIHi_DemanderCommentaire = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIHi, gc_Element_SIHi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd As NotesDocument) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script ajoute une ligne à l'historique du document. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim v As Variant Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_DateFmt As String Dim v_Statut As String
Dim v_NoDerniereLigne As Long Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Long Dim j As Long Dim v_NomItem As Variant
SIHi_BatirHistorique = False
' Initialisations ' ------------------ Call SIHi_Initialisations Set ndb = pnd.ParentDatabase Set nd = New NotesDocument(ndb) nd.Form = "F_SIHi" ' Si le document contient un historique, le supprimer ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Call pnd.RemoveItem(gc_NomItemRT_SIHi) Call pnd.Save(True, False)
' Créer le nouvel item de l'historique ' ----------------------------------------------- Set nrti = New NotesRichTextItem(pnd, gc_NomItemRT_SIHi)
' Boucler sur toutes les lignes d'historique à afficher ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- i = 0 Do While pnd.HasItem(gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i))
v_NomItem = gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i) Set ni = pnd.Getfirstitem(v_NomItem) ni.IsSummary = False
v_Date = xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & CStr(i), "") v_DateFmt = "" If v_Date <> "" Then v_DateFmt = Format(v_Date, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn") v = Evaluate(|@text(| & gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & CStr(i) & |; "S2D0T1Z2")|, pnd) If Len(v(0)) > 16 Then v_DateFmt = v_DateFmt & " " & StrRightBack(v(0), " ") End If End If nd.Date = v_DateFmt
v_NomItem = gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & CStr(i) If pnd.HasItem(v_NomItem) Then Set ni = pnd.Getfirstitem(v_NomItem) ni.IsSummary = False End If v = Evaluate( { @Name([CN]; "} & xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & CStr(i), "") & {")}) nd.Utilisateur = v(0)
v_NomItem = gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi & CStr(i) If pnd.HasItem(v_NomItem) Then Set ni = pnd.Getfirstitem(v_NomItem) ni.IsSummary = False End If
v_Statut = xVar(pnd, v_NomItem, "") If v_Statut <> "" Then nd.Statut = xGDK_xMessage("SI", 57, "", "") & " : " & v_Statut Else nd.Statut = "" End If
v_NomItem = gc_NomItemComm_SIHi & CStr(i) If pnd.HasItem(v_NomItem) Then Set ni = pnd.Getfirstitem(v_NomItem) ni.IsSummary = False End If
nd.Commentaire = xVar(pnd, v_NomItem, "")
Call nd.RenderToRTItem(nrti)
i = i + 1 Loop
Call pnd.Save(True, False) SIHi_BatirHistorique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIHi, gc_Element_SIHi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIHi_RemplacerHistorique(pnd As NotesDocument, pnd_Destination As NotesDocument, _ Byval p_Rebatir As Boolean) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script copie l'historique du document source au document destination.
' Paramètres: pnd NotesDocument. Le document dans lequel il faut ' copier l'historique. ' pnd_Destination NotesDocument. Le document dans lequel il faut ' remplacer l'historique avec celui de pnd. ' p_Rebatir Boolean. Rebâtir le tableau de l'historique après ' avoir ajouté la ligne.
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoDerniereLigne As Long Dim i As Long
SIHi_RemplacerHistorique = False
' Initialisations ' ------------------ Call SIHi_Initialisations
' Retourne dernière ligne de l'historique ' ----------------------------------------------------------------------- v_NoDerniereLigne = SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(pnd)
' Copier les champs de l'historique ' ------------------------------------------------------ For i = 0 To v_NoDerniereLigne If pnd.HasItem(gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi & Cstr(i)) Then Call pnd_Destination.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi & Cstr(i), xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi & Cstr(i), "")) End If If pnd.HasItem(gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i)) Then Call pnd_Destination.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i), xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i), "")) End If If pnd.HasItem(gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & Cstr(i)) Then Call pnd_Destination.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & Cstr(i), xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & Cstr(i), "")) End If If pnd.HasItem(gc_NomItemComm_SIHi & Cstr(i)) Then Call pnd_Destination.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemComm_SIHi & Cstr(i), xVar(pnd, gc_NomItemComm_SIHi & Cstr(i), "")) End If Next
' Rebâtir le tableau de l'historique ' -------------------------------------------- If p_Rebatir Then Call SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_Destination) End If
SIHi_RemplacerHistorique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIHi, gc_Element_SIHi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(pnd As NotesDocument) As Long '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de calculer le numéro de la dernière ligne de l'historique. ' Paramètres: pnd NotesDocument. Le document dans lequel il faut ' ajouter la ligne d'historique. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoCommentaire As Long
v_NoCommentaire = 0
Do While pnd.HasItem(gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(v_NoCommentaire)) v_NoCommentaire = v_NoCommentaire + 1 Loop
SIHi_NoDerniereLigne = v_NoCommentaire - 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIHi, gc_Element_SIHi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIHi_EffacerHistorique(pnd As NotesDocument) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script détruit les zones d'affichage de l'historique. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur Dim i As Long Dim v_NoDerniereLigne As Long
SIHi_EffacerHistorique = False
v_NoDerniereLigne = SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(pnd)
' Si le document contient un historique, le supprimer ainsi que les références aux ' champs qui ont servi à le construire ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemRT_SIHi,"")
For i = 0 To v_NoDerniereLigne
If pnd.Hasitem(gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i)) Then Call pnd.RemoveItem(gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & Cstr(i)) End If
If pnd.Hasitem(gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & Cstr(i)) Then Call pnd.RemoveItem(gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & Cstr(i)) End If
If pnd.Hasitem(gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi & Cstr(i)) Then Call pnd.RemoveItem(gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi & Cstr(i)) End If
If pnd.Hasitem(gc_NomItemComm_SIHi & Cstr(i)) Then Call pnd.RemoveItem(gc_NomItemComm_SIHi & Cstr(i)) End If
Next
Call pnd.Save(True, False)
SIHi_EffacerHistorique = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIHi, gc_Element_SIHi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIHi_Ajouter(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_Statut As String, Byval p_Commentaire As String, _ Byval p_Username As String, Byval p_Rebatir As Boolean) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'ajouter une ligne à l'historique du document. ' Paramètres: pnd NotesDocument. Le document dans lequel il faut ' ajouter la ligne d'historique. ' p_Statut String. Première ligne de l'historique. Sera ' affichée en rouge. ' p_Commentaire String. Le commentaire (optionnel). ' p_Rebatir Boolean. Rebâtir le tableau de l'historique après ' avoir ajouté la ligne. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Suffixe As String
SIHi_Ajouter = False
' Validations ' --------------- If p_Statut = "" And p_Commentaire = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Initialisations ' ------------------ Call SIHi_Initialisations If p_Username = "" Then p_Username = gns_SIHi.Username End If
' Si le document ne contient pas d'historique, le créer ' ----------------------------------------------------------------------- v_Suffixe = Cstr(SIHi_NoDerniereLigne(pnd) + 1)
' Mettre à jour les champs de l'historique ' ------------------------------------------------------ Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemDate_SIHi & v_Suffixe, Now) Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemUser_SIHi & v_Suffixe, p_Username) If p_Statut <> "" Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemStatut_SIHi & v_Suffixe, p_Statut) End If If p_Commentaire <> "" Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(gc_NomItemComm_SIHi & v_Suffixe, p_Commentaire) End If
' Rebâtir le tableau de l'historique ' -------------------------------------------- If p_Rebatir Then SIHi_Ajouter = SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd) Else SIHi_Ajouter = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIHi, gc_Element_SIHi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIHi_AjouterCommentaire(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_Statut As String, Byval p_Username As String, _ Byval p_Rebatir As Boolean, Byval p_Message As String, Byval p_NoCancel As Boolean, _ Byval p_Obligatoire As Boolean, p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de demander un commentaire à l'utilisateur avant d'ajouter une ' ligne à l'historique du document. ' Paramètres: pnd NotesDocument. Le document dans lequel il faut ' ajouter le commentaire. ' p_Statut String. Première ligne de l'historique. Sera ' affichée en rouge. ' p_Rebatir Boolean. Rebâtir le tableau de l'historique après ' avoir ajouté la ligne. ' p_Message String. Le message à afficher dans la fenêtre du ' commentaire. ' p_NoCancel Boolean. Indique si l'utilisateur peut annuler la ' saisie du commentaire. ' p_Obligatoire Boolean. Indique si le commentaire est obligatoire. ' p_Commentaire String. Le commentaire saisi par l'utilisateur. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_Titre As String
SIHi_AjouterCommentaire = False If p_Statut = "" Then v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SI", 49, "", "") Else v_Titre = p_Statut End If
' Demander le commentaire à l'utilisateur ' ------------------------------------------------------- If SIHi_DemanderCommentaire(v_Commentaire, v_Titre, p_Message, p_NoCancel, p_Obligatoire) Then
' Ajouter la ligne à l'historique ' --------------------------------------- If SIHi_Ajouter(pnd, p_Statut, v_Commentaire, p_Username, p_Rebatir) Then p_Commentaire = v_Commentaire SIHi_AjouterCommentaire = True End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIHi, gc_Element_SIHi, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SIHi_InitialisationsUI If gnuiws_SIHi Is Nothing Then Set gnuiws_SIHi = New NotesUIWorkspace End If End Sub

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SICl" ou "SICl" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SICl" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Clie" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSICl As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SICl As NotesDocument Dim gnv_Tabl_xSICl As Notesview Dim gnd_Tabl_xSICl As Notesdocument Dim gnv_Clie_xSICl As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Clie_xSICl As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSICl = "SI Clients" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents ' de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCleClie_xSICl = "Clie_ClientNoFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueClie_xSICl = "V_Clie20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xSICl_xVarProf(Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable du profil de la base de documents.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSICl_Initialisation
' Extraire le document de profil If gnd_Prof_SICl Is Nothing Then Set gnd_Prof_SICl = gndb_xSICl.Getprofiledocument("F_Prof") End If
If gnd_Prof_SICl Is Nothing Then xSICl_xVarProf = p_ValeurNulle Else xSICl_xVarProf = xVar(gnd_Prof_SICl, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End If End Function

Function xSICl_xValeurExisteTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer Dim ni As NotesItem
xSICl_xValeurExisteTabl = False
If Not (xSICl_xndTabl(p_Cle, True) Is Nothing) Then Set ni = gnd_Tabl_xSICl.GetFirstItem("Tabl_Valeurs") If ni.Contains(p_Valeur) Then xSICl_xValeurExisteTabl = True End If End If End Function

Function xSICl_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSICl_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSICl_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSICl_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSICl_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSICl_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSICl_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSICl_xndClie(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSICl_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleClie_xSICl, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSICl, gc_NomVueClie_xSICl, gnv_Clie_xSICl, gnd_Clie_xSICl)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSICl_xndClie = gnd_Clie_xSICl End Function

Function xSICl_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSICl_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSICl_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSICl_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSICl_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSICl_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSICl_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xSICl_xVarClie(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xSICl_xndClie(p_Cle, p_Cache) xSICl_xVarClie = xVar(nd, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSICl_xndTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pCache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_Tabl.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSICl_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd("Tabl_Nom", pCle, pCache, gndb_xSICl, "V_Tabl20", gnv_Tabl_xSICl, gnd_Tabl_xSICl) ' Paramètres: 1 String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il correspond ' au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSICl_xndTabl = gnd_Tabl_xSICl End Function

Function xSICl_xVarTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pNomVar As String, Byval pValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval pCache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document de type F_Tabl.
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xSICl_xndTabl(pCle, pCache) xSICl_xVarTabl = xVar(nd, pNomVar, pValeurNulle) ' Paramètres: 1 Notesdocument. Le document contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ** Appel de la fonction d'extraction du document ** ' 2 String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le document ' recherché. ** Ne pas modifier ** End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SI_NotesDocument"

' Déclarations globales ' ----------------------------------
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIIx = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIIx = "SI_Insertions"

Function SIIx_AppendVarString(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As String, _ p_RemplacerValeurNulle As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Item non trouvé, le créer If ni Is Nothing Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Valeur nulle - remplacer la valeur If Ubound(ni.Values) = 0 And Cstr(ni.Values(0)) = "" And p_RemplacerValeurNulle Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As String Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVarString = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AppendVar(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As Variant, _ p_RemplacerValeurNulle As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Item non trouvé, le créer If ni Is Nothing Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Valeur nulle - remplacer la valeur If Ubound(ni.Values) = 0 And Cstr(ni.Values(0)) = "" And p_RemplacerValeurNulle Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As Variant Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVar = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AppendVarLong(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Valeur As Long, _ p_RemplacerValeurNulle As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim i As Integer
Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Item non trouvé, le créer If ni Is Nothing Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Valeur nulle - remplacer la valeur If Ubound(ni.Values) = 0 And Cstr(ni.Values(0)) = "" And p_RemplacerValeurNulle Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomVar, p_Valeur) Exit Function End If
' Ajouter la valeur Redim a(Ubound(ni.Values) + 1) As Long Forall v In ni.Values a(i) = ni.Values(i) i = i + 1 End Forall a(i) = p_Valeur ni.Values = a
SIIx_AppendVarLong = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomVar, False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SIIx_AppendItemValue(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_ValeurAjouter As Variant Dim a_ValeurActuelle As Variant
' Formatter la valeur à ajouter If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then a_ValeurAjouter = Fulltrim(p_Valeur) If a_ValeurAjouter(0) = "" Then Exit Sub ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter End If Elseif p_Valeur = "" Then ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter Exit Sub Else a_ValeurAjouter = p_Valeur End If
' Ajouter la valeur à l'item du document a_ValeurActuelle = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If Isarray(a_ValeurActuelle) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, Arrayappend(a_ValeurActuelle, a_ValeurAjouter)) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, a_ValeurAjouter) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIIx_AssignerDate(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Date As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndt As New Notesdatetime("") Dim ni As Notesitem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Function End If
If Datatype(p_Date) <> 7 Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Function End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Date Call ndt.Setanytime
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New Notesitem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt
SIIx_AssignerDate = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_MajItem(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant, Byval p_Date As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
SIIx_MajItem = False
If SIND_ValeurItemEgale(pnd, p_NomItem, p_Valeur, p_Date) = False Then If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, p_Valeur) ElseIf p_Date Then Call SIIx_AssignerDate(pnd, p_NomItem, p_Valeur) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, p_Valeur) End If
SIIx_MajItem = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AssignerHeure(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Heure As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndt As New Notesdatetime("") Dim ni As Notesitem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Function End If
If Datatype(p_Heure) <> 7 Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Function End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime If Isdate(p_Heure) Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Heure Call ndt.SetAnyDate
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New Notesitem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt
SIIx_AssignerHeure = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Roles As Variant Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace
' Doit avoir le rôle Admin pour utiliser cette action v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) <> 1 Then Messagebox "Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à utiliser cette action.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase If ndb.IsFTIndexed Then Call ns.SendConsoleCommand(ndb.Server, "load updall " & ndb.FilePath & " -F") End If Exit Sub

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_GDK"

Dim gns_VAdmS As notesSession Dim gndb_VAdmS As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_VAdmS As notesuiworkspace Dim gnuiv_VAdmS As notesuiview
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_VAdmS = "SL" Const gc_Element_VAdmS = "V_AdmS"

Sub VAdmS_acRestaurer '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_Restaurer As Boolean Dim v_HistoNS As String Dim nd_Parent As NotesDocument
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VAdmS.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 112, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", Cstr(ndc.Count))) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_Restaurer = False If nd.HasItem("HistoRS") Then Set nd_Parent = nd.ParentDatabase.GetDocumentByUNID(xvar(nd, "HistoRS", "")) If Not (nd_Parent Is Nothing) Then v_Restaurer = True End If Else v_Restaurer = True End If
If v_Restaurer Then v_HistoNS = xVar(nd,"HistoNS","")
' Restaurer le document nd.form = xVar(nd, "FormOriginal", "") Call nd.RemoveItem( "FormOriginal" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoNS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS100" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoUS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoPS" ) If nd.HasItem("HistoRS") Then Call nd.MakeResponse(nd_Parent) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoRS" ) End If nd.HistoDM = Now nd.HistoUM = gns_VAdmS.UserName Call nd.Save(True,False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1
' Restaurer les sous-documents If v_HistoNS <> "" Then Call VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(nd, v_HistoNS) End If End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.CurrentView.Deselectall Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 114, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(pnd As Notesdocument, p_NoAdmS As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As Notesdocument
' Supprimer les documents réponses-de-réponses Set ndc = pnd.Responses If Not (ndc Is Nothing) Then If ndc.Count > 0 Then Set nd = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd Is Nothing If xVar(nd, "Form", "") <> "F_AdmS" Then ' Restaurer le document nd.form = xVar(nd, "FormOriginal", "") Call nd.RemoveItem( "FormOriginal" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoNS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS100" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoUS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoPS" ) nd.HistoDM = Now nd.HistoUM = gns_VAdmS.UserName Call nd.Save(True,False)
' Restaurer les sous-documents Call VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(nd, p_NoAdmS) End If
Set nd = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop End If
End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_Initialisations If gns_VAdmS Is Nothing Then Set gns_VAdmS = New notesSession Set gndb_VAdmS = gns_VAdmS.CurrentDatabase
Set gnuiws_VAdmS = New notesuiworkspace Set gnuiv_VAdmS = gnuiws_VAdmS.CurrentView End If End Sub

Sub VAdmS_acViderCorbeille '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 211, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 10, "", "")) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nv = gndb_VAdmS.GetView("V_AdmS") Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Supprimer le document Call nd.Remove(True) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 113, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_acSupprimerSelection '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VAdmS.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 111, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", Cstr(ndc.Count))) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Restaurer les sous-documents Call nd.Remove(True)
v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 113, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_NAB" Use "x_SIEm"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gnuiws_SICJ As NotesUIWorkspace
Dim gns_SICJ As Notessession Dim gndb_SICJ As Notesdatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SICJ = "SL" Const gc_Element_SICJ = "SI_Jabber"

Function SICJ_Telephoner(Byval p_NoTelephone As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de communiquer en utilisant Jabber. ' Actions : T = Téléphoner, C = Clavarder (chat) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
SICJ_Telephoner = False
If p_NoTelephone = "" Then Exit Function End If
p_NoTelephone = Lcase(Replace(p_NoTelephone, Evaluate(|" " : "-" : "(" : ")"|), "")) If Instr(p_NoTelephone, "x") > 0 Then p_NoTelephone = Strleft(p_NoTelephone, "x") End If
' If Len(p_NoTelephone) >= 7 Then ' p_NoTelephone = "9" & p_NoTelephone ' End If Call ShellExecute(0&, "open", "tel:" & p_NoTelephone, Null, "", SW_SHOW) SICJ_Telephoner = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICJ, gc_Element_SICJ, Lsi_info(2), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICJ_DemarrerJabber(p_NoEmploye As String, p_Action As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de communiquer en utilisant Jabber. ' Actions : T = Téléphoner, C = Clavarder (chat) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim s As String
SICJ_DemarrerJabber = False
If p_NoEmploye = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Téléphoner ' ------------- If p_Action = "T" Then s = xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoEmploye, "Empl_PosteTelephonique", "", True) If SICJ_Telephoner(s) Then SICJ_DemarrerJabber = True End If
Exit Function End If
' Clavarder ' ------------- s = xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoEmploye, "Empl_NotesId", "", True) If s = "" Then Exit Function End If
s = xNAB_xVarPerson(s, "InternetAddress", "", True) If s = "" Then Exit Function End If
Call ShellExecute(0&, "open", "xmpp:" & Lcase(s), Null, "", SW_SHOW) SICJ_DemarrerJabber = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICJ, gc_Element_SICJ, Lsi_info(2), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICJ_Initialisations As Boolean SICJ_Initialisations = False
If gns_SICJ Is Nothing Then Set gns_SICJ = New Notessession Set gndb_SICJ = gns_SICJ.Currentdatabase
Set gnuiws_SICJ = New NotesUIWorkspace
SICJ_Initialisations = True End If
SICJ_Initialisations = True End Function

Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_NAB" ou "NAB" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Function xSIEm_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSIEm_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSIEm_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSIEm_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSIEm_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSIEm_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSIEm_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_NotesAPI" Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

Const NSF_INFO_SIZE = 128 Const INFOPARSE_DESIGN = 3 Const NOTE_ID_ICON = &HFFFF0010
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SINDB = "SL" Const gc_Element_SINDB = "SI_NotesDatabase"

Function SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim dp As String Dim s% Dim rc% Dim hDB As Long Dim dbserver$ Dim dbfilepath$ Dim nri As SINAPI_DBREPLICAINFO
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = False
dbserver$ = pndb.Server dbfilepath$ = pndb.Filepath
dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
s% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dp$, hDB)
If hDB = 0 Then Exit Function
If dbserver$ = "" Then rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dbfilepath$, hDb) Else rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dbserver$ & "!!" & dbfilepath$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
' Droits Admin requis pour executer, sinon erreur 'Set nr = pndb.ReplicationInfo 'Call nr.ClearHistory() 'Call nr.Save()
' Vider historique de réplication rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDB, nri) rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClearReplHistory( hDB ,0 ) rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDB, nri)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Impossible de vider l'historique de réplication : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClose(hDB)
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SINDB_RefreshDesign(templateserver$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim s As Integer Dim hDB As Long s% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dp$, hDB) If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
SINAPI_DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Sub SINDB_SetDesignTemplate(templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) SINAPI_NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_ndGetDesignElement(pndb As NotesDatabase, p_TypeElement As String, p_NomElement As String) As NotesDocument ' PAS TESTÉ ************************************** On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nnc As NotesNoteCollection Dim s As String Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nnc = pndb.CreateNoteCollection(False) Select Case p_TypeElement Case "F": nnc.SelectForms = True Case "V": nnc.SelectViews = True Case Else Call nnc.SelectAllDesignElements(True) End Select ' nnc.SelectionFormula = |@IsMember("F_Tabl"; @GetField("$Title"))| Call nnc.BuildCollection
s = nnc.Getfirstnoteid Do Until s = "" Set nd = ndb.GetDocumentById(s) Set ni = nd.Getfirstitem("$TITLE") If ni.Contains(p_NomElement) Then Set SINDB_ndGetDesignElement = nd Exit Do End If s = nnc.Getnextnoteid(s) Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDB_ChangerIDReplique(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Server As String Dim FileName As String Dim Rep As String Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim hDb As Long Dim rc% Dim RepInfo As SINAPI_DBREPLICAINFO Dim var As Variant
SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = False server$ = pndb.Server filename$ = pndb.FilePath Do Set ndb = New NotesDatabase("", "") rep$ = Right("00000000" & Cstr(Clng(Today)), 8) & Right("00000000" & Cstr(Int((Now - Today) * 100000000)), 8) Loop Until Not ndb.OpenByReplicaID(server$, rep$)
If Server$ = "" Then rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(FileName$, hDb) Else rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(Server$ & "!!" & FileName$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: L'information de la réplique n'est pas disponible : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
RepInfo.ID.Innards(1) = Val( "&H"+Left$( rep$, 8 ) ) RepInfo.ID.Innards(0) = Val( "&H"+Right$( rep$, 8 ) )
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDb, RepInfo) ' take a deep breath... :-)
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo) If rc% <> 0 Then Print "*** Impossible de vérifier si le nouvel ID de réplique a été modifié correctement : " & pndb.Title Else Print "Le nouvel ID de réplique de la base de documents « " & pndb.Title & " » est " & Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(1)), 8) + ":" + Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(0)), 8) End If
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClose(hDb) SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SINDB_ReplaceDesign(templateserver$, templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) SINAPI_NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
Dim hNT As Long SINAPI_NSFNoteOpen hDB, NOTE_ID_ICON, 0, hNT SINAPI_NSFItemSetText hNT, "$TITLE", d$, Instr(d$, Chr$(0)) SINAPI_NSFNoteUpdate hNT, 0 SINAPI_NSFNoteClose hNT
SINAPI_DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_NotesURL(pndb As NotesDatabase) As String ' Retourne l'URL permettant d'ouvrir un document dans Notes. ' Format: Notes://DbReplicaId/ViewNoteUNID/DocUNID On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Serveur As String Dim v_URL As String
If pndb Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
v_Serveur = pndb.Server If v_Serveur = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_URL = "Notes://" & StrRight(StrLeft(v_Serveur, "/"), "=") & "/" & pndb.Replicaid SINDB_NotesURL = v_URL
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Declare Function FindExecutable Lib "shell32.dll" Alias "FindExecutableA" (ByVal lpFile As String,_ ByVal lpDirectory As String, ByVal lpResult As String) As Long

Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LEFT" ' // Left Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LEFT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LEFT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LINEFEED", "LF" ' // Linefeed = ^J intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NEWLINE", "NL" ' // New line = Carriage return & Line Feed = ^M^J For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMLOCK" ' // Numeric Lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMLOCK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMLOCK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGDN", "PAGEDOWN", "NEXT" ' // Page Down intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NEXT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NEXT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGUP", "PAGEUP", "PRIOR" ' // Page Up intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRIOR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRIOR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PRINTSCREEN", "PRTSC" ' // Print Screen intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRINT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRINT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "RIGHT" ' // Right Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RIGHT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RIGHT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SCROLLLOCK", "SCRLK" ' // Scroll lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SCROLL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SCROLL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "TAB" ' // Tab = ^I intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_TAB, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_TAB, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "UP" ' // Up Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_UP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_UP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SLEEP" ' // We sleep for a few seconds DoSleep lngNumberOfPushes * 1000 Case "F1" ' // F1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F2" ' // F2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F3" ' // F3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F4" ' // F4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F5" ' // F5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F6" ' // F6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F7" ' // F7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F8" ' // F8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F9" ' // F9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F10" ' // F10 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F10, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F10, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F11" ' // F11 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F11, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F11, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F12" ' // F12 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F12, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F12, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F13" ' // F13 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F13, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F13, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F14" ' // F14 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F14, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F14, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F15" ' // F15 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F15, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F15, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F16" ' // F16 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F16, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F16, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F17" ' // F17 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F17, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F17, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F18" ' // F18 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F18, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F18, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F19" ' // F19 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F19, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F19, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F20" ' // F20 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F20, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F20, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F21" ' // F21 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F21, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F21, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F22" ' // F22 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F22, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F22, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F23" ' // F23 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F23, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F23, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F24" ' // F24 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F24, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F24, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD0" ' // Numeric Keypad 0 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD0, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD0, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD1" ' // Numeric Keypad 1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD2" ' // Numeric Keypad 2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD3" ' // Numeric Keypad 3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD4" ' // Numeric Keypad 4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD5" ' // Numeric Keypad 5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD6" ' // Numeric Keypad 6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD7" ' // Numeric Keypad 7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD8" ' // Numeric Keypad 8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD9" ' // Numeric Keypad 9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADMULTIPLY", "NUMPAD*" ' // Numeric Keypad Multiply intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_MULTIPLY, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_MULTIPLY, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADADD", "NUMPAD+" ' // Numeric Keypad + intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ADD, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ADD, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADSUBTRACT", "NUMPAD-" ' // Numeric Keypad - intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SUBTRACT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SUBTRACT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDECIMAL", "NUMPAD." ' // Numeric Keypad . intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DECIMAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DECIMAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDIVIDE", "NUMPAD/" ' // Numeric Keypad / intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DIVIDE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DIVIDE, intScanKey Next lngCtr
Case "~", "!", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "+","|", "{", "}",_ """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushShiftKey strOriginalCode Next lngCtr
Case Else ' // Ordinary keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushKeys strOriginalCode Next lngCtr End Select Exit Sub
lblPushFNKey_Errs: ' // Should only occur when the number of pushes isn't an integer lngNumberOfPushes = 1 Resume Next End Sub

Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_DBSeCour As Notessession
Dim gnuiws_SeCour As Notesuiworkspace Dim gnuid_SeCour As NotesUIDocument Dim gnd_SeCour As NotesDocument
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_DBSeCour= "SL" Const gc_Element_DBSeCour = "DB_SeCour"

Sub DBSeCour_Initialisations On Error Goto GererErreur
If gns_DBSeCour Is Nothing Then Set gns_DBSeCour = New Notessession
Set gnuiws_SeCour = New Notesuiworkspace Set gnuid_SeCour = gnuiws_SeCour.CurrentDocument Set gnd_SeCour = gnuid_SeCour.Document End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_DBSeCour, gc_Element_DBSeCour, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub DBSeCour_hsSelectionnerModele '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Sélection d'un modèle du courriel de l'utilisateur '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dim ndb_Courriel As NotesDatabase Dim ndc_Modele As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Modele As NotesDocument Dim v_MailServer As String Dim v_DbMail As String
'Initialisations Call DBSeCour_Initialisations
v_DbMail = gns_DBSeCour.GetEnvironmentString("MailFile", True) v_MailServer = gns_DBSeCour.GetEnvironmentString("MailServer", True) Set ndb_Courriel = gns_DBSeCour.GetDatabase(v_MailServer, v_DbMail)
Set ndc_Modele = gnuiws_SeCour.PicklistCollection(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, _ True, ndb_Courriel.Server, ndb_Courriel.FilePath, "Stationery", xGDK_xMessage("SICl",2, "", ""),_ xGDK_xMessage("SICl", 1, "", ""))
If ndc_Modele.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If

If Not gnuiws_SICo.Dialogbox("DB_SeCour", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Sélectionnez les paramètres de sélection", _ nd_DB, True) Then Exit Sub End If

Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", gc_NomBaseSICo), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function Elseif Not gndb_SICo_SICo.IsOpen Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable.
